classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In measure(), after queue.get() the main process calls probe.read_staged(path_for(...,'class_a',...)) synchronously and only then sleeps, so the main rank stalls waiting for each class_a read while the prefetch worker keeps running independently, and each of the cell.items files is read exactly once.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b files are read inside the separate _prefetch worker process via probe.read_staged in a loop that runs concurrently with the main process's compute sleep, so the read is overlapped with computation and only the worker (not the main rank) is involved in each read, with each of the cell.items files read once.
